text: Driving home from a party, Jane [runs over a young woman|trigger|a sudden accident or attack], and her photographer boyfriend Tun keeps her in the car as they leave the girl on the road. Soon [pale shadows and faces surface in Tun's photographs|images|pictures, screens and recordings], his neck aches without cause, and his old college friends begin killing themselves. Jane learns the girl was Natre, a shy student Tun once loved in secret, [who threatened to die when he left her|wants|a lover to possess]. A hidden set of negatives holds [what Tun has never forgiven himself for|wrong|failing to protect].
